text:
name: Verify Mailloop
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: mailloop
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: mailloop
          POSTGRES_DB: mailloop
        ports: ["5433:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U mailloop -d mailloop"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://mailloop:mailloop@localhost:5433/mailloop
      AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      AUTH_SECRET: ci-only-session-secret-do-not-use-in-production
      TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ci-only
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ci-only
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run db:deploy
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run test:usage:db
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: browser-evidence
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14
      - run: npm run build
